# Message Console

## Generated by AI: message_console.py
I had figured out most of the UI for my Pomodoro Timer app, but wasn't sure how to tackle my requirements for a message console to display system / error / validation / and processing messages to the user. So I asked Google. This was the result. It's quite a handy app for learning Tkinter, and it only took me a couple hours to modify it for my use in my Pomodoro Timer app.

✨ Features
- A dynamic message console that expands and contracts based on the visible lines in the console
- Error messages are differentiated in the console by red text
- The Application Controls section contains buttons that display varying lines of text in the console so you can see how it works

#### To run, navigate to the folder where you saved the script and type: python message_console.py
